scientific_integrity: Exact enumeration in degrees 1,2,3 plus the genus-three Weil functional equation; full Hasse-Witt coefficients reproduced by separate multinomial arithmetic. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact six-form zeta-spectrum classification is restricted to one geometric isomorphism class in characteristic 13; prior work already classified generic sextic twists, automorphism group and geometric exceptional locus. The polynomials do not distinguish quadratic twists and do not classify Jacobian polarizations; possible unindexed prior exact arithmetic remains a risk.
title: Three Weil spectra among the six forms of the exceptional genus-three bielliptic Picard curve over F13
